propositions: _paged_search loops indefinitely when a server ignores or repeats the startAt offset, causing unbounded growth of the results list instead of terminating

get_parent_map and all three fetcher.fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) swallow a pagination stall error via broad except Exception blocks, converting loud abort into silent degraded snapshot
A server that returns the same page for consecutive startAt requests proves the offset is not advancing; detection on the second call prevents runaway iteration
The fix must place BackendPaginationStallError in core _backend.py so fetcher.py can name it without importing adapters, and re-raise it ahead of all four fail-open handlers
Well-behaved page-capping DC servers must remain unchanged, recovering the full issue set; the short-page heuristic from fetcher does not apply here because DC caps every page as normal behavior
